features: High-Resolution Wireless Audio – Equipped with Qualcomm aptX HD codec to deliver crystal-clear 24-bit audio at 48 kHz, ensuring Hi Fi sound over Bluetooth.
Room-Filling 2.1 Sound – A powerful HiFi speaker system designed to produce rich bass, clear mids, and crisp highs, loud enough to fill a 300 sq. ft. room effortlessly.
Powerful Dual 6” Subwoofer Drivers – Enjoy deep, punchy, and distortion-free bass powered by a dual-driver subwoofer unit that delivers room-shaking lows ideal for music, movies, and gaming.

Premium Silk Dome Tweeter + 4” Woofer Satellites – Each satellite features a refined silk dome tweeter paired with a 4” woofer, delivering crystal-clear vocals, natural treble, and rich midrange for an authentic HiFi experience.
Elegant & Functional Design – A sleek 2.1 speaker system engineered for both living rooms and personal setups, combining style with superior sound performance.
